groups.decision: Adopt actual finite bond/controller rules with FS-10 and Animal Companion’s final procedure; no generic beast creation or extra phase.

original.profile: AC12+floor(current ownerPB/2); dynamic maximumHP5+current total owner level; all ordinary saves use current ownerPB alone; other ability checks use template ability modifiers, no PB unless a real source grants it. Template INT3 is a feat-profile value, not proof that a real source beast meets the INT<7 admission gate.
original.nativeBody: Preserve actual original source profile, body identity, current health ratio, size, breathing, conditions, disease, hunger, custody and age. Templates replace only their stated combat/ability/speed values for this bond. Any actual anatomy incapacity/sensory blocker remains. No template creates a supernatural sense, trait, hand or extra body.
original.actions: One command and offensive allowance across owner companions/devices per numbered round. Commanded body has one attached phase after whole owner regular turn, move plus chosen legal attack or standard Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge; Dash adds one currentSpeed to its phase cap, Disengage suppresses opportunities for that phase, Help follows actual5ft/physically possible aid and expires at the next original companion-start marker. No independent BA/Reaction/turn/death save; no extra-turn phase. Uncommanded only defensive movement/Dodge.
original.conversion: Admission requires a real living animal with positiveHP and positive maximumHP and an actual eligible willing/tamed receipt. Initial and release conversion preserves health ratio using max(1,floor(newMax*oldHP/oldMax)), not a heal/damage event. At0 the feat animal is dead, never eligible for conversion. Save the prior source profile rather than deriving a new one on release.
original.recovery: No resummon, free rest healing, unprinted Hit Dice or new original animal from a saved profile. External legal healing/resurrection retains its actual costs and rules; resurrection returns the same body unbonded, and new bonding still requires the post-death completedLR plus full procedure. Capacity change never repairs injury, replenishes resources or creates death/HP-loss triggers.

groups.decision: Adopt all three complete NEW body templates for matching real animals only. Their fixed body, movement, senses, attack, HP conversion and custody remain separate from class and mount templates.

original.name: Ground companion
original.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record
original.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small or Medium terrestrial Beast with ordinary biting anatomy; preserve its actual size. Dog/fox-like examples are illustrative, not free supplied animals.
original.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no automatic level scaling.
original.sense: Choose its actually sourced keen hearing OR smell, if present, for advantage on that sense's actual Perception checks. No new keen sense if absent.
original.limits: No Pack Tactics, knockdown, grapple, multiattack, burrow or extraordinary source powers. Carrying uses this actual body/STR and ordinary Load/pounds limits, real harness/hands. A mount must separately meet real riding eligibility.

original.name: Flying companion
original.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record
original.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Tiny winged Beast that already possesses natural flight and a pecking/biting attack. No Hover.
original.attack: One melee peck/bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d4piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.
original.sense: Retain actual sourced keen sight, if present, as advantage on that sense's Perception checks; no automatic darkvision/blindsight.
original.limits: No free Flyby, invisibility, aerial carrying exception, Hover, multiattack or ability to carry a Medium ally. Ordinary falling, weather, carrying and support apply.

original.name: Swimming companion
original.status: NEW feat-only profile, not a recovered monster record
original.eligibleBody: An actual positive-HP living Small Beast with native swimming and biting anatomy. Keep its real breathing requirements; a fish gains no lungs and an air breather gains no gills.
original.attack: One melee bite, reach5ft, attack=ownerPB+owner actualWIS modifier, damage1d6piercing; no addedWIS damage and no level scaling.
original.sense: Retain one actually sourced keen hearing OR smell, if present, for that sense's Perception advantage only.
original.limits: The5ft ground movement is crawling/flopping for a body without legs, paying ordinary crawl cost and suffocation/exposure; no new hands, amphibiousness, Water Breathing, multiattack or sonar.

groups.decision: Adopt all six NEW feat-only maneuvers and their actual die/action/target/DC limits; no Warrior/Soldier maneuver feature or extra full Action is granted.

original.name: Measured Strike
original.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
original.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.
original.basis: NEW attack-check enhancement; not an imported Battle Master maneuver.

original.name: Driving Shove
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
original.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
original.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.
original.basis: NEW finite bonus on reviewed ordinary Shove; printed feat/class save-based Shoves are not this maneuver.

original.name: Disarming Feint
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
original.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.
original.basis: NEW finite die on reviewed ordinary Disarm only.

original.name: Guarding Deflection
original.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
original.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.
original.basis: NEW finite physical defense using current whole-event/damage-provenance interface.

original.name: Measured Advance
original.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
original.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.
original.basis: NEW bounded movement procedure; no copied Soldier grant.

original.name: Rallying Signal
original.activation: Action under the ordinary Rally procedure
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Action
original.procedure: Choose one actual ally within30ft able to perceive the rally and one active source-qualifiedFrightened record. Before rolling the ordinaryCHA task check at its sourceDC (otherwise10), spend/roll thed6 and add its face to the total. Apply actual task degrees/natural shift; success ends only that selected record. NoHP/tempHP, loyalty, extra save, new ally turn or automatic cure of other fear records.
original.basis: NEW finite die on current reviewed Rally.

groups.decision: Adopt exactly seven existing Wizard rank1 placements as NEW Ritual-tag overlays for the stated route; use actual current payloads and Wizard-owned-book/outside-encounter requirements. No ordinary source tag or class status is rewritten.

Adopt all seven finite supplement groups: seven copy profiles, separate CHA Eldritch Blast, three pact sigils, three plant modes, three minor-buff transfers, three Time tags and three nature-class routes. Correct only copy classification/boon arbitration and explicit plant phases as below. Exact payload/status originals remain historical.

copyProfileContract.status: NEW proposed finite feat-copy interface; the five actual Mirrorsage cards/engine are comparisons, not automatic grants.
copyProfileContract.capture: Capture only one directly witnessed resolved component that actually expresses one profile below. Record canonical source/event, actual original spell rank or pre-encounter monster effective rank, native magnitude before external bonuses/defenses, selected type/profile and qualifying own casting route. For monster abilities without a spell rank, use max(1, min(9, ceil(actualCR/2))); missing CR needs a rating assigned before the encounter, never a favorable after-the-fact guess. No unique/legendary/boss feature without an independently reviewed exception; no copying copies, class engines, actions, resources, permanent changes, resurrection, creation, items or protected information. An unsupported role is ineligible, not a blank Director permission.
copyProfileContract.rankAndPayment: For original rank 0, q=0; otherwise q=max(1, floor(originalRank/2)). The chosen actual owned spellcasting route must independently support learning q; merely owning a pool or feat prerequisite does not. Use that route’s real ability for attack/DC and spell components V/S, normal rank price 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 plus actual adjustments. It grants a temporary feat-copy route only, never the original full spell. Spellcasting time is oneAction. At release pay/cast/history/interrupt once, with copy-provenance flags disabling copy/resource/class-proc chains. An explicit source such as Mirrorsage retains its own actual profile/rank/payment instead of being silently converted.
copyProfileContract.numericBound: For numeric damage/heal/ward select one witnessed native component/type and record its rolled or fixed magnitude B before external bonuses, saves, defenses and recipient caps. If that magnitude was hidden, the Director records it privately; no free identification is given. At feat-copy release roll (q+1)d6, then bound the native numeric result to min(roll, floor(B/2)). No copied critical multiplier, external damage/heal modifier, converted excess or extra recipients. Actual recipient defenses and healing limits still apply. A zero ceiling cannot produce a numeric benefit. This is an explicit NEW meaning of half potency, not an assertion about original undefined wording.
copyProfileContract.lifecycle: At most one feat-copy release per owner per numbered round across Eldritch Echo, Mimicry and adapted copies. A Mirrorsage owner also spends its existing shared release allowance; an unowned Mirrorsage engine is not granted. Strike/Burst/Mend are immediate. Ward/Hindrance/Boon/Step use their stated maximum two-interval duration; source-specific shorter hold deadlines still govern. Only one pending feat-copy record across Eldritch Echo/Mimicry; before a new capture choose whether to replace the old, losing its paid capture/use without refund. Adaptation may retain permission but creates no second release allowance. No copied effect grants extra Action/BA/Reaction, persistent body, loot, learning or concentration capacity.

profiles.range: 60 ft, one perceived creature with line of effect

profiles.range: Point within 30 ft;10 ft radius, at most 3 originally declared perceived creatures in area with line of effect
profiles.resolution: DEX save vs own DC for bounded numeric observed-type damage, half on success; one shared roll. No original riders. Instant.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing living creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: Restore bounded numeric HP under actual prohibitions/maximum/Critical caps. No reviving, healing dice add-ons, Wound cure, heal-copy/resource trigger or excess conversion. Instant.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing living creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: Offer bounded numerictemp HP into the actual single grant ledger, ending at the source’s second future regular start. Rejected offer wastes the copy. No linked riders.

profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived creature with line of effect
profiles.resolution: WIS save vs own DC or Speed−10 ft and no new Reactions until its next future regular end, never later than the source’s second future regular start. Strongest slow arbitration; no wholeAction/turn denial, repeated save or original hard-control rider.

profiles.role: A source actually granting a positive attack, save or AC modifier
profiles.range: 30 ft one perceived willing creature with line of effect

groups.decision: Adopt four actual NEW small gadget profiles, not the Tinker Gnome’s different clockwork statistics/costs/lifetime. Real5gp stock,1lb body and all actual fuel/custody/deadlines remain.

original.name: Shaded lamp
original.procedure: Action light or extinguish the integral enclosed wick. While lit it gives bright light10ft and dim light another10ft for the remaining gadget lifetime. No fuel inventory, attack, ignition of other objects, magical darkness penetration or restored illumination item is created.

original.name: Line bell
original.procedure: Action fix the gadget and its attached5ft non-load-bearing thread across one reachable ground passage. An actual body crossing and physically touching the taut thread rings an ordinary bell audible30ft, then the thread releases and the device becomes inert. It neither detects incorporeal/noncontact passage nor reveals identity/location beyond its physical site, restrains, trips or causes damage. A visible thread can be noticed by ordinary senses; it has no automatic hidden DC.

original.name: Light clamp
original.procedure: Action attach/remove the clamp to a reachable mundane edge no more than2inches thick. It can hold one unattended or willingly presented object of at most5lb against that edge, falling normally on expiry/destruction. It cannot restrain a creature, secure a door against forced entry, support a climber, substitute for restraints or improve a check. No free hand is created.

original.name: Hand fan
original.procedure: Action crank while held to move ordinary air through a5ft cone until the start of your next regular turn; sustained use needs anotherAction. It can cool a touched/hands-reach surface for comfort and stir loose paper/dust, without mechanical damage, creature movement, suffocation relief, weather/hazard immunity or removal of a rules-defined gas/cloud. It can visibly show ordinary airflow but identifies no substance.
